notes: All five relevant electro-dragon sources were read. Four use ten Electro Dragons as the main army; L8NYban_eLc uses four to funnel a ground push. Every complete composition is different, so there is no unique modal full army. NLIGb_T2Ll0 represents the dominant ten-Electro-Dragon plan; its ten-Totem inventory has no majority support.

The default army follows NLIGb_T2Ll0. Log Launcher, Troop Launcher and Sky Wagon listed in its own troop section are carried siege options and are excluded from ordinary troops. Its reinforcement Sky Wagon is retained in cc. No siege deployment, support-troop deployment or Poison placement is narrated.
Variants require their source-specific armies and equipment. The prescribed variant shape has no army override; replacing steps alone does not change the default inventory.

XtLqXV-ab6U alternative: Electro Dragon 10, Balloon 8; Earthquake Spell 2, Lightning Spell 6, Revive Spell 2, starting Totem count unknown. Reinforcement troops are Super Yeti 1 and Super Valkyrie 1; siege options are Battle Blimp, Log Launcher, Siege Barracks and Troop Thrower. The encoded variant selects Siege Barracks. Heroes are Dragon Duke, Grand Warden, Minion Prince and Archer Queen. Stated loadouts are Warden [Eternal Tome, Rage Gem], Minion Prince [Meteor Staff, Dark Orb], Queen [Giant Arrow, Healer Puppet]. Duke equipment and pets are unidentified; Action Figure replaces Healer Puppet in the third replay.

f-qsCT8GujY alternative: Electro Dragon 10, Balloon 10, Minion 1; Earthquake Spell 4, Lightning Spell 3, Totem Spell 3, Poison Spell 1. Reinforcements remain unresolved. Log Launcher, Troop Launcher and Sky Wagon are carried options without deployment instructions. Queen and Warden loadouts match the default; Minion Prince uses [Meteor Staff, Dark Orb, Spirit Fox], and Duke uses [Rocket Backpack, Fire Heart, Phoenix].

vbPEc45cUK4 alternative: Electro Dragon 10, Rocket Balloon 4, Super Wall Breaker 1; Freeze Spell 3, Totem Spell 6, Poison Spell 1, Skeleton Spell 1. Reinforcements are Minion 1, Balloon 1, Super Minion 4 and Rage Spell 2. Its link lists Log Launcher, Flame Flinger and Siege Barracks options and two reinforcement Siege Barracks; these counts do not establish multiple deployed sieges. Loadouts are Queen [Action Figure, Giant Arrow, Frosty], Warden [Eternal Tome, Healing Tome, Sneezy], Minion Prince [Meteor Staff, Dark Orb, Phoenix], Duke [Fire Heart, Stun Blaster, Angry Jelly].

L8NYban_eLc alternative: Electro Dragon 4, Super Wall Breaker 2, Ruin Witch 6, Ice Golem 3, Balloon 3; Rage Spell 2, Revive Spell 3, Freeze Spell 1; cc Log Launcher 1, Super Yeti 1, Super Valkyrie 1, Poison Spell 1, Totem Spell 3. Troop Launcher and Siege Barracks are carried alternatives; the narrated siege is Log Launcher. Loadouts are Royal Champion [Rocket Spear, Electro Boots, Spirit Fox], Queen [Healer Puppet, Action Figure, Frosty], Warden [Rage Gem, Eternal Tome, Greedy Raven], Duke [Fire Heart, Revenge Deck, Phoenix].

t=0 denotes the narrated opening. Citation times are transcript positions, not battle delays. Every after delay is zero because no numerical battle delay is stated. After duke approximates an established funnel; after the flank Rages approximates the ground variant's established funnel. Neither trigger measures whether exterior buildings have been cleared.

Support counts distinct videos describing the shared action or rule; equipment and precise timing can differ. Queen-first and Duke-first openings both occur. The Rocket Backpack variant retains Duke-first order. Rapid Warden and Minion Prince deployment is explicitly supplied by XtLqXV-ab6U.

Orb timing follows vbPEc45cUK4's permitted activation together with Eternal Tome. NLIGb_T2Ll0 supplies alignment advice without an activation time. The allowed vocabulary cannot specify directional ability aiming; entry positions and facing must supply the Arrow, Dark Orb and Rocket Backpack alignment.

The default Totem step encodes one placement. group_inside approximates an advancing army, and threat:main approximates a threatening defense in front of it. No source supplies a numerical repeat cadence, so additional moving placements are unscheduled. Freeze casts with unidentified targets are also unscheduled.

Revive inventories are retained. NLIGb_T2Ll0 normally prioritizes Duke; XtLqXV-ab6U prefers him later; L8NYban_eLc revives him immediately when needed, reserves spells for him when uncertain, and allows other heroes when overkilling. Revive steps are unencoded because unit anchors resolve only living units and the allowed vocabulary has no fallen-hero anchor.

Spell combinations are expanded into individual casts because the executor casts one spell per step. Zero delays preserve the source counts without inventing spacing. building:revenge approximates the chosen compartment. Use the Siege Barracks Zapquake variant when that compartment offers the described value and the main army can take the Town Hall quickly.

The Rocket Backpack variant selects the demonstrated Revenge Tower target and a secondary Spell Tower on the crossing. building:swt approximates that selected tower. Duke activation uses the zero-delay fallback for an unstated activation time. Queen is selected from the explicit Electro Dragon-or-hero opposite-flank option.

The Rage-assisted variant applies when the flank needs help. edge:funnel approximates that flank. The Skeleton target is captioned only as bomb pipe; threat:main is a coarse proxy, and no defense identity is asserted. Exact Electro Dragon spacing is unspecified.

In the ground variant, individual hero order is unspecified; the listed order serializes their deployment. Queen ability is immediate as stated. Super Wall Breaker count all commits the two listed breakers together, although the count per narrated placement is unknown. Wall-break and Totem ordering varies; the encoded order follows the protected-entry narration. heavy_fire approximates the Warden or Champion needing early protection without inventing an HP threshold.

XtLqXV-ab6U also describes a Battle Blimp Town Hall snipe before the main deployment, with Super Yeti and Super Valkyrie, then Minion Prince on the left and Electro Dragons on the right. The vocabulary has no Town Hall-destroyed trigger, so this sequence is retained here without inventing a wait. Its suggested inventory adjustment is one fewer Revive and two Totems.

Hero substitutions are source-specific: XtLqXV-ab6U suggests Royal Champion for an underleveled Duke; vbPEc45cUK4 suggests Barbarian King with Angry Jelly and Stick Horse, or Royal Champion with Rocket Spear and Seeking Shield. Complete substitute loadouts are unspecified.
